_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Platform Object Model Package (POMP)
summary: The Platform Object Model Package (POMP) provides recommended improvements to the Navy Aviation Simulation Master Plan (NASMP) Standard, used by the Government to update NASMP federation agreements, object models, and related documentation.
use_relationship:
The Platform Object Model Package (POMP) provides recommended improvements to the Navy Aviation Simulation Master Plan (NASMP) Standard, which is comprised of: NASMP Federation Agreements Document (FAD), NASMP Federation Object Model (FOM), Guidance Rationale and Interoperability Manuals (GRIMs) and Interest Matrix (IM). The POMP will be used by the Government to update the NASMP standard; NASMP Federation Agreements Document (FAD) (Naval Air Warfare Center Training Systems Division, 12211 Science Dr. Orlando, FL 32826, 407-380-4379).

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described in the contract Statement of Work.

This DID supersedes DI-ADMN-82157.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.content: The POMP shall contain the following:

children.title: Cover and title page shall contain the following:
The POMP shall define the changes to the NASMP FOM.
children.content: These object model files may be organized by application-specific Base Object Models (BOMs).

children.title: Corresponding Guidance, Rationale, and Interoperability Manuals (GRIMs) in the POMP document the submitted extensions to the NASMP FOM, organized by BOM.
The POMP shall update the Interest Matrix (IM), defined by the NASMP FAD, in accordance with the trainer's federates' current publication and subscription settings.
The POMP shall contain the collection of Change Requests (CRs) for both the NASMP FOM and the NASMP FAD.
